approved_scope.category_description: current German-market regular shampoos for healthy users with cosmetic hair/scalp needs; explicit deep cleansers stay in the regular-shampoo cohort (deep-cleanser entry classified under its own category rules)

normative_in_standard.R2_R3: three-tier thickness fit (T1/T5) and projected live weight (W-LIVE, T7)
normative_in_standard.R4: scalp-concern floor (T6); scalp match stays exact
normative_in_standard.R5: no-gap apply gate N1 and exception register entry X1 (Monday Volume, coarse x oily)
normative_in_standard.R12: comfort wording bundled with a dandruff claim never projects a target; research-only researchCombinationTargets
normative_in_standard.R15: a separate sensitive-scalp unit on a dandruff-primary product never projects a secondary sensitive target
normative_in_standard.R16.1: the same for a separate dry-scalp unit; research-only combination value dry
normative_in_standard.R16.2: only D1-true explicit deep cleansers with a strong formula record clarifying; strong oily-scalp shampoos without D1 record regular
normative_in_standard.R16.3: a deep-cleanser entry needs a strong formula; D1 on an ordinary formula gets the informational note deep_cleansing_name_ordinary_formula instead of a review flag
normative_in_standard.R16.4: E4, C2 humectant and CSA lists stay closed; additions deferred to one batch decision after the Track A/B research
normative_in_standard.R17.1: a dandruff claim plus a recognized anti-dandruff active (S-DANDRUFF passed) is always the primary target, even when the product name names another target (S-PRIMARY)
normative_in_standard.R17.2: a dandruff-primary product projects no secondary target at all (no oily, sensitive or dry rows); oily joins sensitive and dry as a research-only researchCombinationTargets value (gate: the S-OILY formula clause; never dry together with oily)
normative_in_standard.R17.3: an anti-dandruff active without a dandruff claim makes a regular shampoo: no dandruff target, every other target decided as without the active, only the note active_without_dandruff_positioning

post_calibration_rulings.basis: R13: lock path without a third calibration round; R14 approved the lock. Rule-changes rows 102-108. R17 was ruled after the lock and applied in place before the locked package was first published (rule-changes rows 109-114); the receipt and manifest pins were refreshed with it.
post_calibration_rulings.expected_effect: R15/R16.1 remove sensitive/dry secondary rows from dandruff-primary products (conservative; N1 must confirm the irritated and dry cells before any apply); R16.2 turns strong oily-scalp shampoos without D1 from amber to green for oily scalp (by ruling); R16.3 turns the ordinary-formula D1 review flag into a note; R16.4 changes nothing; R17.1 makes a passing dandruff target primary even when the name names another target (dandruff rows only; conservative); R17.2 removes oily secondary rows from dandruff-primary products (conservative; e.g. H&S Classic Clean, not recommended live; N1 must confirm the oily cells before any apply) and adds the research-only oily combination; R17.3 writes down the existing reading that an active without a dandruff claim is a regular shampoo (no change)

known_limits_retained: R15 and R16.1-R16.4 were applied after the unseen check v2 and were not exercised by two sealed lanes.

R17.1-R17.3 were ruled after the lock and applied in place before publication; they were not exercised by two sealed lanes, and the oily combination value and the dry-plus-oily contradiction rule have no calibrated record.
The unseen check covered six products; the dandruff + dry combination value (R16.1) and the ordinary-formula D1 note (R16.3) have no calibrated record.
Lane agreement measures repeatability, not finished-product or consumer accuracy; INCI order is a prominence proxy, never a concentration.
Exception register entry X1 (Monday Volume, coarse x oily) stays a temporary bridge until a lighter oily-scalp shampoo passes review (R5).
Closed ingredient lists may be too narrow; additions wait for the batch decision after the Track A/B research (R16.4).
AUSSIE Bouncy Curls stays needs_research until its formula source is re-verified.
